changes.before: The Committee expects that further gradual increases in the target range for the federal funds rate will be consistent
changes.after: The Committee judges that some further gradual increases in the target range for the federal funds rate will be consistent

changes.before: Risks to the economic outlook appear roughly balanced.
changes.after: The Committee judges that risks to the economic outlook are roughly balanced, but will continue to monitor global economic and financial developments and assess their implications for the economic outlook.

changes.before: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2 to 2-1/4 percent.
changes.after: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 2-1/4 to 2‑1/2 percent.

changes.before: and the unemployment rate has declined.
changes.after: and the unemployment rate has remained low.

parsed.rationale: The rate hike was widely expected, while the addition of "some" before further gradual increases and the new caveat about monitoring global economic and financial developments signal a shallower remaining tightening path. On net, the forward guidance moved in a dovish direction.
